storyTemplate.title: Classroom Dragon
storyTemplate.description: A substitute teacher at a small magic academy discovers the class pet is a dragon nobody remembered to mention.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
Classroom 3 goes silent the moment you pick up the attendance slate.

Something inside the supply closet snorts smoke.

Nell Harrow whispers from the doorway.

(Nell Harrow) "If that is the class pet, please know the roster did not mention scales."
